summary: This is an 8-K filed by Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders held on April 29, 2026. Shareholders voted on four items: appointment of Ernst & Young as auditor (approved with 99.88% for), advisory say-on-pay (87.48% for), advisory say-on-climate (approved), and election of fourteen directors (all elected). The filing is a routine current report of shareholder meeting results, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed.
